source_name: Football-Data.co.uk historical results and betting odds CSV archives
source_owner_provider: Football-Data.co.uk (Joseph Buchdahl); odds compiled from Betbrain.com, OddsPortal, and individual bookmakers
source_category: public downloadable historical football results and bookmaker odds CSV
access_method: direct public HTTPS CSV download; no scraping or access-control bypass
terms_of_use_status: The download page states that the data is free and provides files for quantitative testing of betting systems. The disclaimer disclaims correctness and betting liability. No standalone data license or explicit general redistribution grant was found on the reviewed public pages.
licensing_or_redistribution_status: Controlled internal research and retention of the specifically downloaded files is approved from the express free-download/quantitative-testing invitation; raw redistribution and public republishing are not approved.
commercial_use_status: Not established by the reviewed public pages; commercial and externally redistributed use require a separate rights review.
storage_permission: Approved only for bounded operator-controlled raw research storage outside Git with immutable hashes; no raw publication or redistribution.
derived_data_permission: Approved for controlled internal research outputs, subject to GoalVision timestamp and leakage gates; this review does not authorize model publication or activation.
historical_coverage: Season CSV archives back to 1993/94; this review/import is bounded to German D1 seasons 2022/23, 2023/24, and 2024/25. A 2025/26 D1 archive was confirmed available but not downloaded.
competition_coverage: The archive advertises 22 divisions from 11 football nations for recent seasons; this bounded review uses German Bundesliga D1 only because it is the competition in the immutable GoalVision split.
bookmaker_coverage: Season-dependent individual bookmaker columns. Reviewed explicit columns include Bet365, Bwin, Interwetten, Pinnacle, William Hill, BetVictor, 1xBet, Betfair Sportsbook, and Betfair Exchange where present. Market Max/Avg aggregations are not treated as bookmakers.
market_coverage: Individual-bookmaker full-time 1X2 and over/under 2.5 are in GoalVision scope; Asian handicap and aggregate Max/Avg fields are excluded from this task.
timestamp_precision: Match Date and Time are present and interpreted as Europe/London local fixture time. No per-row or per-quote odds capture timestamp exists.
quote_semantics: Provider notes call non-C odds pre-closing/first-set odds collected after market opening and C columns closing odds. The fixture page describes a general Friday-afternoon and Tuesday-afternoon collection schedule, but no row binds a quote to a capture instant.
event_identity_quality: Competition code, match date/time, home team, and away team are present; no shared event ID. Deterministic linking requires explicit competition/team aliases and exact UTC kickoff after Europe/London conversion.
rate_limits: No documented archive rate limit found; acquisition is deliberately bounded to three German D1 season files.
reliability_assessment: Useful as immutable real raw odds evidence and deterministic event-link coverage, but ineligible for GoalVision calibration/backtesting because true row-level capture time and the fixed 24-hour pre-kickoff cutoff cannot be proven. No source schedule time is fabricated onto a row.
operator_note: APPROVED_FOR_CONTROLLED_RESEARCH authorizes only bounded raw acquisition, retention outside Git, parsing, hashing, and linkage. Every odds cell remains normalization-rejected with UNKNOWN_CAPTURE_TIME. Publication, calibration, comparison, shadow, audit passage, promotion, and activation are not authorized.
redistribution_permission: not approved; no explicit raw-data redistribution license found
update_cadence: season archives with recent results updated by the provider; file Last-Modified metadata is retained through retrieval evidence where observed
